name: old_snapshot_threshold
description: Maximum age of a snapshot before it may trigger 'snapshot too old' errors; enables early vacuuming of dead tuples to prevent bloat.
symptoms: table bloat due to retained dead tuples
tuning_tips: Set to a value (in minutes) slightly longer than your longest expected query or transaction duration; avoid extremes—too low increases 'snapshot too old' errors, too high delays vacuum and risks bloat. Requires server restart.
